name: MPAY
recent: ManagePay 将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日召开第 16 届年度股东大会，并寻求股东批准更新现有经常性关联交易授权。公司于 8 月 28 日举行特别股东大会，股东批准了拟议发行股份和拟议股本削减。最新季度（2026 年 6 月 30 日止）营收环比和同比均增长，但净亏损为 460 万令吉。
notable: 将于 2026 年 11 月 27 日举行第 16 届年度股东大会。
2026 年 8 月 28 日特别股东大会通过拟议发行股份及拟议股本削减。
并将在股东大会上寻求批准。
risks: 最新季度净亏损 460 万令吉，净利率为 -62.4%。
董事 Dato' Chew Chee Seng 于 2026 年 10 月 1 日转让 900 万股（0.872%）。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收为 737.5 万令吉，环比增长 194.8%，同比增长 56.3%；净亏损为 460.3 万令吉，净利率为 -62.4%，较上一季度的 -102.9% 有所收窄。

recent_en: An EGM on 28 Aug 2026 approved the proposed share issuance and proposed share capital reduction. In the latest quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue grew both QoQ and YoY, but the company recorded a net loss of RM4.603 million.
notable_en: EGM on 28 Aug 2026 approved the proposed share issuance and proposed share capital reduction.
Proposed renewal of existing recurrent related party transactions mandate to be tabled for shareholder approval at the AGM.
risks_en: Latest quarter recorded a net loss of RM4.603 million with a net margin of -62.4%.
Director Dato' Chew Chee Seng transferred 9,000,000 shares (0.872%) on 1 Oct 2026.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 Jun 2026, revenue was RM7.375 million, up 194.8% QoQ and 56.3% YoY; net loss was RM4.603 million with a net margin of -62.4%, compared with -102.9% in the previous quarter.
